sloka: यद् उक्तम् कपि राजेन रावण अवरजम् प्रति ।वाक्यम् हेतुमद् अत्यर्थम् भवद्भिर् अपि तत् श्रुतम् ॥६-१७-३२॥।।
transliteration: yad uktam kapi rājena rāvaṇa avarajam prati ।vākyam hetumad atyartham bhavadbhir api tat śrutam ॥6-17-32॥।।

translations.english: "The highly reasonable words of advice given by the king of Vanaras about Ravana's brother was heard even by you."
